question: Please list the zip code of all the charter schools in Fresno County Office of Education.
predicted_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.Zip FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 AND T2."District Name" = 'Fresno County Office of Education'

question: How many schools with an average score in Math greater than 400 in the SAT test are exclusively virtual?
predicted_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.Virtual = 'F' AND T2.AvgScrMath > 400
